answer: The Dedicated device bound by callback verification with a public binding record makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a orchard is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. When the jade settles over the whisper, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
